high_dimensional_structural.theorem_statement: For n ≥ 5, all known mechanisms for obstructing negative Einstein metrics rely on four-dimensional structure: the Einstein Chern-Weil identity 8π²χ = ∫|W|² + (2/3)λ²V or the self-dual splitting Λ² = Λ⁺ ⊕ Λ⁻. Neither survives above dimension 4.
high_dimensional_structural.n_2m_ge_6: Pfaffian cross terms prevent |W|²+λ² definiteness, no topological upper volume bound, BCG has nothing to contradict
high_dimensional_structural.positive_side: Gromov bound: Ric≥0 → ‖M‖=0 works in all dimensions and obstructs λ≥0 with positive simplicial volume
high_dimensional_structural.consequence: Refutation of Yau-26 for n≥5 requires inventing a new obstruction mechanism. Dimension 4 is the only dimension where either hemisphere is presently decidable.

n=4.also: Λ² splits as Λ⁺ ⊕ Λ⁻ → gauge theory invariants
